works.title: Software Engineer
works.company: Vestel Electronics R&D Corp - Vestel Group

achievements.description: Developed and maintained a multi-language, multi-branded Smart TV web portal deployed across 80+ countries and 50 brands.
Integrated and maintained web applications optimized for Smart TV environments.
Contributed to internal management and reporting tools supporting the Smart TV platform.
Developed an iOS prototype application for IP camera and NVR device control, integrating a C++ SDK into a Swift-based iOS application.
Designed and developed a multi-language, role-based e-commerce web platform, owning application architecture, backend services, database management, and UI implementation.
Sole iOS developer responsible for end-to-end design and development of a production-ready augmented reality iOS application.
Implemented real-time AR features using ARKit and RealityKit, including 3D room layout generation, interactive object placement, and dynamic texture and lighting updates.
Built Chamber Interior Design, an AR-based interior design app evolving from academic research into a real-world product.
Delivered end-to-end development of production iOS applications using Swift, SwiftUI, and UIKit.
Built and shipped AR and utility-focused apps, owning architecture, feature development, and App Store releases.
Developed MobleAR, a real-time AR design application supporting USDZ models, interactive placement, and real-time visualization.
Created PasswOCD, a secure password generator focusing on usability, data safety, and platform-specific password generation.
Sole iOS developer responsible for the design and development of native iOS AR applications.
Designed and maintained the iOS app architecture with a focus on performance, stability, and scalability.
Built AR features using Swift (async/await), ARKit, and RealityKit, including real-time LiDAR scanning and 3D model generation.
Applied MVVM-C and Clean Architecture patterns to support modularity, testability, and long-term maintainability.

A cutting-edge LiDAR-based application that allows users to create accurate 3D models of real-world objects with ease. Using AR Capture, users can scan items to generate detailed 3D representations, which can then be shared through a QR code, enabling others to instantly view the model without additional software.

An immersive augmented reality application that enables users to visualize 3D models in real-world environments instantly. Built with ARKit and RealityKit, it supports interactive model placement, scaling, and rotation with realistic lighting and shadows. AR Viewer leverages App Clips for instant access, allowing users to preview models without installing the full app.

educations.major: Electrical Eng. and Computer Science, M.Sc.
